Understanding SQLite FTS5

FTS5 is the full-text search extension that ships with SQLite since version 3.9.0.

Ranking with bm25

The built-in bm25() function returns lower values for better matches, so results are ordered ascending.

Tokenizers

The default tokenizer is unicode61. The trigram tokenizer was added in SQLite 3.34.0 and enables substring matching.

Hidden tracking text should be ignored

External content tables

An external content table stores only the index, while the text lives in another table referenced by content_rowid.
